content: Sinɑ bokon ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe dɑɑ torɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔmɑ sɔɔ. U rɑ ɡu ɡɔsiewɑ mi u kĩ.
Tɔnu u rɑ n tɑmɑɑ win swɛɛ kpuro yi dɛɛrewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ ɡɔ̃ru wɛ̃ɛri.
Wi u sĩimɔ dee dee, win dɑɑ yɑ yɑ̃kuru kere Yinni Gusunɔn mi.
Tii suɑbu kɑ tɔn biɑru yerɑ yɑ rɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobun durum sɔ̃ɔsi.
Wi u kookɑri mɔ̀ u kɑ win sɔmburun kpunɑɑ ko, u koo ten ɑrufɑɑni wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u rɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ko kɑ sɛndɑru, ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ koo nùn deemɑ.
Dukiɑ ye bɑ wɑɑmɔ kɑ weesu, yɑ rɑ doonɛwɑ nɡe wiisu. Gɔɔ sɔɔrɑ yɑ rɑ kɑ bu de.
Tɔn kɔ̃sobun bɔbunu nu rɑ bu kɑm koosiewɑ, domi bɑ ǹ kĩ bu sĩ dee dee.
Tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ ku rɑ swɑɑ mwɛ ye yɑ dɛnde, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ dɛɛre, ben swɑɑ yɑ rɑ n dee dee sɑ̃ɑ.
N burɑm bo ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ wunɛ turo dii piibu sɔɔ, ye kɑɑ n kɑ wɑ̃ɑ dii bɑkɑru sɔɔ kɑ kurɔ wi u sɑnnɔsu kĩ.
Tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ n kĩwɑ u kɔ̃sɑ ko kɑ win ɡɔ̃ru kpuro. Bɑɑ win bɔrɔ u ku rɑ deri.
Bɑ̀ n tɔn yɑɑ kɑsikio sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ, lɑɑkɑri sɑriruɡii u rɑ bwisi kowɑ. Bɑ̀ n bwisiɡii keu mɔ̀, u rɑ yɛ̃ru sosiwɑ.
Gusunɔ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡemɡii, u rɑ n mɛɛrɑwɑ ye yɑ koorɑmɔ tɔn kɔ̃son yɛnuɔ, kpɑ u nùn kpɛ̃ɛ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ.
Wi u yinɑ u sɑ̃ɑron wuri nɔ, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ win tiiɡii nɔɔmɔ ù n somiru kɑnɑmɔ.
Nɔm birɑn kɛ̃ru tɑ rɑ mɔru suresiewɑ.
Gem kobu bu rɑ ɡemɡii nuku dobu wɛ̃wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ kɔ̃sɑ yɑ rɑ kɔ̃sɑn kowo kɑm koosie.
Wi u ɡɛrɑ lɑɑkɑrin swɑɑn di, ɡɔribɑ u koo dɑ u deemɑ.
Wi u duniɑn ɑkɑnde kpuro kĩ, u ku rɑ n ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ. Mɛyɑ wi u rɑ tɑm kɑ dĩɑ duronu kɑ̃, u ku rɑ ɡobi yi.
Tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ koo nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ te ɡemɡibɑ kun wɑsi.
N burɑm bo ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ wunɛ turo dii piibu sɔɔ, ye kɑɑ n kɑ wɑ̃ɑ dii bɑkɑru sɔɔ kɑ kurɔ sɑnnɔsuɡii.
Bwisiɡiin yɛnuɔrɑ dukiɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ ni nu wɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ win dukiɑ sɑnkuwɑ.
Wi u kɑsu u ko dee dee kpɑ u n sɑ̃ɑ tɔn ɡeo, win wɑ̃ɑrɑ koo dɑkɑɑ dɑ, kpɑ bu nùn ɡem kookoosu sɔ̃ɔsi kɑ bɛɛrɛ.
Bwisiɡii u rɑ kpĩ u du tɑbu durɔbun wuuɔ, kpɑ u ben dɑm buɑ mɛ bɑ nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
Wi u rɑ win yɑrɑ nɛnɛ u tii nɔni swɑ̃ɑru ɡbɑrɑmmɛwɑ.
Wi u tii sue u rɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ dɑbinu yɑɑ kɑsikiwɑ, kpɑ tii suɑbu bu sɔ̃ɔsirɑ win kookoosu sɔɔ.
Yikuron binɛ yɑ rɑ nùn ɡowɑ yèn sɔ̃ u ku rɑ sɔmburu ko.
Bɑɑdommɑ ɡɑbu bɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ binɛ sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡii u rɑ kpuro wɛ̃wɑ sere u tii duɑri.
Tɔn kɔ̃son yɑ̃kuru tɑ ku rɑ Gusunɔ wɛ̃re. Kɑɑ sere ɡere te u kɑ bwisiku kɔ̃sunu mɔ̀?
Bɑ ku rɑ weesuɡiin seedɑ dibu wure, ɑdɑmɑ wi u seedɑ dimɔ ye u nuɑ kɑ ɡem, bɑ koo de u ɡɑri ɡere n kɑ tɛ.
Tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wi u nɑɑnɛ mɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡii u rɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ u ɡeɑ mɔ̀.
Tɔnun bwisi kɑ win lɑɑkɑri kɑ win bwisikunu, yen ɡɑɑ kun kpɛ̃ yu Gusunɔn himbɑ sĩiyɑ.
Tɔnu u koo kpĩ u win dumi tɑbu yɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu sebusiɑ tɑbun sɔ̃, ɑdɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ tɔnu nɑsɑrɑ wɛ̃.
